sec: sec:B008: Protect AI system deployment environment / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:B008: Protect AI system deployment environment / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Enforcing data integrity across agentic interfaces. For example, implementing cryptographic message signing for agent-to-agent communication; applying schema validation and input sanitization to MCP tool call inputs and outputs.

sentences.text: Enforcing data integrity across agentic interfaces.
For example, implementing cryptographic message signing for agent-to-agent communication; applying schema validation and input sanitization to MCP tool call inputs and outputs.

blocks.id: blk:B008: Protect AI system deployment environment / Control mays/2
blocks.text: Securing model hosting environments. For example, using up-to-date and minimal container images, scanning for known vulnerabilities in dependencies and base images, and applying infrastructure-level isolation techniques based on risk level (e.g. container namespaces, VM separation, or dedicated GPU access).

sentences.text: For example, using up-to-date and minimal container images, scanning for known vulnerabilities in dependencies and base images, and applying infrastructure-level isolation techniques based on risk level (e.g. container namespaces, VM separation, or dedicated GPU access).

blocks.id: blk:B008: Protect AI system deployment environment / Control mays/3
blocks.text: Verifying model integrity before and during deployment. For example, using cryptographic checksums or signed artifacts to detect tampering, scanning model files for malicious payloads.
